title: BioIVT: Follow-up and Outcome read demographics from the Short Form
description: On Follow-up and Outcome, looks up date of birth, gender, race and ethnicity (and DIN on Outcome) from the subject's Short Form. When found, the original question hides and a read-only line shows the value; when not found, the original question shows exactly as before. 'Other race, specify' is left alone: it already hides whenever Race is hidden, and another convention owns its show/hide rule.
rationale: Option C: cross-form autofill (CDASH best practice: collect once). Dan: do not defer. The fail-safe means a failed lookup cannot block data entry.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan
